adjudicated_statement: For C66-TATE-SUPPORT at (g,n)=(6,6), over C with Q-coefficients, let T:=W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(M_{6,6};Q) and let T_Z be the ATT-0120/FND-0180 kernel-form subobject T_Z=ker(T->W_{26}H^{26}(M_{6,6} minus Y;Q)(21))=im(W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y;Q)->T), where Y is the reduced Zariski closure of the CE classifying image. The hypothesis RED-0001 that T is a finite direct sum of Q(8) is sufficient for T_Z to be a finite direct sum of Q(8), because T_Z is a subobject of the pure polarizable weight -16 structure T and FND-0033 applies (equivalently, a sub-Q-Hodge-structure of a structure of pure type (-8,-8) is again of pure type (-8,-8)). That hypothesis is not necessary: Tate type of T_Z does not force Tate type of T, since non-Tate summands of T may lie in a complementary subobject. Consequently no artifact may assert that discharging C66-TATE-SUPPORT requires settling RED-0001. Only the contrapositive is valid as a necessity statement: a non-Tate subquotient of this named T_Z refutes RED-0001. The implication 'T Tate implies T_Z Tate' is already the content of FND-0033 applied to the FND-0180 datum and is therefore not a weakest sufficient input for the assigned unconditional theorem. FND-0185 records a logically incomparable sufficient hypothesis, that W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y;Q) is a finite direct sum of Q(8), which concerns a closed support of dimension at most 20 (at most 17 only after the FND-0187 PGL_2-quotient repair) and does not settle T; sufficiency in one direction confers no necessity in the other. FND-0185 does not itself prove T_Z Tate and does not discharge C66-TATE-SUPPORT. FND-0186 records dimension-threshold vanishing of kernel-form terms K(Y') for dim(Y')<8 and of constant or product models with classifying-image closure of dimension at most 2; it does not determine the Tate type of T_Z and does not discharge C66-TATE-SUPPORT. A C66-TATE-SUPPORT artifact whose only Tate antecedent is RED-0001 cannot occupy the weakest-sufficient-proof lane: the implication is already adjudicated, FND-0185 supplies a sufficient hypothesis that does not settle T, and assuming the campaign target in order to prove a subproblem that is an input to C66-TATE-ASSEMBLY of that same target is circular in the campaign DAG. Distinct from FND-0168(2), which records circularity of a different equivalence (K Tate versus spanned by Hodge (8,8)-classes). Not asserted: that T or T_Z fails to be Tate; that W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y) is Tate; support-exhaustion T_Z=T.
contradiction_resolution: Mandatory first reads: ATT-0122/CLM-0122-1 proves the implication T Tate => T_Z Tate by the kernel inclusion of ATT-0120/CLM-0120-4 and semisimplicity of pure polarizable Q-Hodge structures; REV-0174 confirms CLM-0122-1 and notes that even polarizability is surplus once the ambient object is of pure type (-8,-8). ATT-0122/CLM-0122-2 correctly records only the contrapositive (a non-Tate subquotient of T_Z refutes RED-0001); REV-0174 confirms that half and states that the converse necessity is false. The contested uniqueness claim is ATT-0122/CLM-0122-5 together with novelty_claim 2: 'the only missing input for the proof direction is the Tate property of T' and 'no other route can discharge this subproblem without settling that object'. REV-0174 fails that conjunct. Independently: (i) FND-0033 already supplies the subquotient implication, so the RED-0001-conditional is not new; (ii) FND-0180 identifies T_Z with im(W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(Y)->T), so Tate-ness of the Y-group is a different sufficient input (FND-0185), logically incomparable with RED-0001 because non-Tate summands of the Y-group may die in the map to T and non-Tate summands of T may lie off T_Z; (iii) ATT-0122 Section 6 items (ii) and (iii) themselves list other sufficient routes, contradicting the uniqueness assertion internally. Candidate wording overstates two packet facts and is therefore corrected, not promoted unchanged. FND-0185 is a Gysin-free sufficiency lemma whose own not_covered list includes both the Y-group Tate hypothesis and necessity of that hypothesis; it does not prove T_Z Tate and does not discharge C66-TATE-SUPPORT. FND-0186's mathematical_scope is degree-16 Borel-Moore dimension vanishing and nested-kernel monotonicity; its not_covered list and closing sentence both say it does not determine the Tate type of T or T_Z. Those two findings therefore cannot be described as 'already discharging the subproblem'. They do, however, refute necessity of RED-0001 as a unique missing input: FND-0185 is a sufficient hypothesis that does not settle T, and FND-0186 constrains supports without being a Tate-type route. Campaign circularity is a DAG obstruction, not a mathematical falsehood of the implication: C66-TATE-ASSEMBLY depends on C66-TATE-SUPPORT in order to assemble the exact target, which at (6,6) is RED-0001, so an artifact whose only Tate antecedent is RED-0001 cannot occupy the weakest-sufficient-proof lane. Distinct from FND-0168(2), which records a different circularity (K Tate iff spanned by Hodge (8,8)-classes). No claim-level contradiction with CONJ-0001, THM-0001--THM-0007, OBS-0001, or RED-0001: the finding does not assert that T or T_Z fails to be Tate. Primary-source checks: Canning-Larson-Payne arXiv:2307.08830v3 / Forum Math. Pi 12 (2024) e23, Theorem 1.1 note, records that the Hodge structure on cohomology of a smooth proper Deligne-Mumford stack is semi-simple; the same paper's (6.1) is the Borel-Moore right-exact sequence H_k(partial~) -> H_k(Mbar) -> W_{-k} H_k^{BM}(M) -> 0, which is the global form of the localization used to identify T_Z as an image, not as T itself; Theorem 1.5(3) discharges even homology only through k<=14, and the introduction records k=16,18,20 as predicted Tate but open, so RED-0001 remains undischarged. Deligne, Theorie de Hodge II, Publ. Math. IHES 40 (1971), is the classical source that mixed Hodge structures form an abelian category with strict morphisms; polarizable pure Q-Hodge structures of fixed weight are semisimple, which is the content of corroborated FND-0033. Merge target: none (complementary to FND-0185, which does not adjudicate non-necessity of RED-0001, and to FND-0168(2), which is a different circularity).
